params.why: keep every term of the cubic and quotient present

params.name: t2
params.let: ("+ " if A > 0 else "- ") + (str(abs(A)) if abs(A) != 1 else "") + "x^2"

params.name: t1
params.let: ("+ " if B > 0 else "- ") + (str(abs(B)) if abs(B) != 1 else "") + "x"

params.name: q1
params.let: ("+ " if b > 0 else "- ") + (str(abs(b)) if abs(b) != 1 else "") + "x"

solution: Let $P(x)=x^3 {=t2} {=t1} {=t0}$. The constant term is {=C}; try its divisors in $P(a)$.
$P({=r1})=0$, so $x {="- " if r1 > 0 else "+ "}{=abs(r1)}$ is a factor.
Divide $P(x)$ by this factor (synthetic division by {=r1}): the quotient is $x^2 {=q1} {=q0}$ with remainder 0.
notes: Basic: cubic with three distinct nonzero integer roots, one of them 1 or -1 (the first value to test, as in book exercise 15). Roots in [-4,4]; all coefficients nonzero. Quotient always factorises over integers.
